title: Sri Lanka: Systematic Country Diagnostic Update
temporal_coverage: Diagnostic published January 2022; includes reported historical disaster losses and climate risk context.
methodology: Diagnostic update synthesizing newer analysis, prior studies, and stakeholder consultations.
limitations: Synthesizes studies of varying dates and methods; not a new attribution study.

title: Nationally Determined Contributions Implementation Plan (2021-2030)
organization: Ministry of Environment, Government of Sri Lanka
temporal_coverage: Published July 2023; operationalizes updated NDC commitments for 2021-2030.
methodology: Government plan operationalizing sectoral mitigation and adaptation actions under the 2021 NDC through an inclusive, multi-stakeholder process.
limitations: The plan is a statement of intended actions; it notes that finances, technology, and human capital may constrain implementation.

title: Sri Lanka, World Bank Sign Agreement to Strengthen Climate Resilience
temporal_coverage: Press release dated 2021; includes projections through 2050 and a planned climate resilience project.
methodology: Official World Bank release about a government program financing agreement and associated climate-risk estimates.
limitations: The page summarizes estimates without their scenario/model specifications; project benefits are expected, not realized outcomes.

title: Gender Responsive Climate Security Assessment for Sri Lanka
organization: UN Women; United Nations Development Programme (UNDP); UN Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs (DPPA); Adelphi Research
temporal_coverage: Field assessment published 30 September 2025; district-specific recommendations are proposals, not later outcomes.
methodology: Gender-responsive climate-security assessment using district hotspot selection, field research and stakeholder consultation.
limitations: The official PDF download returned 403; claims use only official indexed excerpts and the UN publication page. No uninspected passages are asserted.

title: Remarks by the UN Resident Coordinator Marc-André Franche at the Launch of the Gender Responsive Climate Security Assessment
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator Office in Sri Lanka
temporal_coverage: UN launch remarks delivered 1 October 2025, drawing on the assessment and reported local examples.
methodology: UN speech summarizing assessment findings and local examples.
limitations: Reported examples; no incidence estimates or impact evaluation.

title: Cyclone Ditwah Situation Report: Sri Lanka, 8 December 2025-28 January 2026
organization: United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) Sri Lanka
temporal_coverage: Cyclone Ditwah emergency and early recovery reporting from 8 December 2025 to 28 January 2026.
methodology: UNFPA report using DMC figures, needs assessments, safety audits and response data.
limitations: Time-specific estimates and agency outputs; some cited risk methods were not independently reviewed.

title: Implementation of Strategic Frameworks for Science-Driven Disaster Resilience - Tropical Cyclonic Storm Ditwah
organization: Office of the Cabinet of Ministers, Government of Sri Lanka
temporal_coverage: Cabinet press briefing dated 9 March 2026 on decisions and recommendations following Cyclone Ditwah in November 2025.
methodology: Official Cabinet press briefing summarizing a post-disaster institutional research-needs exercise and approved resilience proposals.
limitations: The page labels the briefing subject to confirmation at the next meeting; it describes approved proposals, not implementation or evaluated results.
